subject.title: exec private-LAN access fails while same user GUI/LaunchAgent succeeds

question: Should this issue be resolved by the diagnostic-only exec warning in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94045, or should OpenClaw pursue same-user private-LAN reachability parity for gateway-host exec?
rationale: The source proves the missing diagnostic, but changing private-LAN reachability semantics would affect exec, sandbox, Codex, and SSRF expectations and needs maintainer security intent.

options.title: Land Diagnostic Only
options.body: Review and land the open diagnostic PR while keeping broader LAN access policy under the related private-network trackers.

options.title: Design Access Parity
options.body: Treat same-user GUI/LaunchAgent reachability as the product goal and require a separate security design before implementation.

options.title: Defer To Broader Trackers
options.body: Reject the diagnostic-only scope and keep this issue under the existing private-network policy issues.

recommendation.title: Land Diagnostic Only
recommendation.body: Review and land the open diagnostic PR while keeping broader LAN access policy under the related private-network trackers.

likelyOwner.reason: The exec runtime/docs history most consistently routes the current source and product boundary through steipete.
